name: PAE byte-length encoding (V11 regression)
spec: DSSE PAE = literal 'DSSEv1' SP LEN(type) SP type SP LEN(payload) SP payload. Release and production share the stdlib encoder. The official worked vector must match before parsing the current manifest: exactly two length-prefixed byte fields follow the literal prefix. Context-length prefixes, binary lengths, wrong fields and trailing bytes fail. This is byte conformance; signature and signer authorization require separate verification.
